label: For "Coding Agent Prompt Injection Defence": Detect and neutralise hostile instructions hidden in issues, code comments, dependencies and web pages that coding agents read, so untrusted text cannot steer the agent to leak data or run harmful commands. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Prompt-only defence.
